description: Custom Hermes-first example: a recurring field-ops work item from a custom application webhook, routed through Hermes into a local operating loop.

project.description: A local custom department workspace for rehearsing Hermes-routed field-maintenance coordination.
project.primaryGoal: Reduce recurring field-maintenance coordination delays without dispatching vendors automatically.
project.sourceOfTruth: The custom operations app is authoritative for maintenance request status.

answers.source_of_truth: The custom operations app owns maintenance request status; Airtable owns asset metadata.
answers.event_sources_subjects: Hermes receives custom_app custom_work_item.blocked events keyed by maintenance request ID.
existing_automations: Slack reminder when a request waits more than 48 hours

answers.trigger_or_cadence: A custom app event says a maintenance request is blocked or overdue.
answers.problem_signal: A maintenance request is blocked and missing owner, next action, or required evidence.
current_steps: ask lead to approve vendor or schedule changes
answers.pain_type_severity: Coordination delay is medium severity and creates hidden follow-up work.
answers.baseline: Five days average blocked request age

answers.read_write_boundary: Read custom app and asset exports; draft reminders only; no vendor dispatch, spend, cancellation, or schedule change without approval.

answers.guardrail_metric: no unapproved vendor or spend action
answers.baseline_target: Reduce blocked request age from five days to two days.
verification_rules: draft cites request ID and asset ID

answers.urgency_priority: Critical maintenance beats routine reminders; otherwise keep one route per request.
answers.pilot_scope: one region and one maintenance request type
answers.management_summary: weekly blocked request age and owner-latency summary
